Description.SourceString:
In the lifespan of Ashenfall, the Alcarrid tribe have only existed for a heartbeat. They are a mishmash of exiles, runaways and rebels from the other tribes, forming a clan out of necessity. They believe that it is marginally safer to gather together and draw the ire of Fuzan, than it is to survive alone against the kalphite. 

What makes the Alcarrid stand out is that they have all resisted the norm in some way. They are critical thinkers, and often doers rather than talkers. It makes Alcarrid Oasis the perfect soil to grow a rebellion against Fuzan.
